articles.title: India, Russia moving confidently to achieve USD 100 billion trade target by 2030: Ambassador
articles.summary: India and Russia are confidently progressing towards a bilateral trade target of USD 100 billion by 2030. Ambassador Vinay Kumar confirmed that efforts are actively underway to diversify and expand the trade basket beyond traditional areas. This initiative signifies deepening economic cooperation and a robust partnership, aiming to broaden the scope of engagement between the two nations across various sectors.

articles.title: India showcases hypersonic missiles at Republic Day parade (VIDEO)
articles.summary: India marked its 77th Republic Day with a grand parade in New Delhi, prominently showcasing its military prowess. The event highlighted India's robust defence capabilities, featuring advanced systems like the Russian-made S-400 air defense system. This display underscored the nation's strategic strength and commitment to national security, offering valuable insights for aspiring defence personnel.

articles.title: ‘Bigg Boss 5’ fame Sidharth Bhardwaj returns to reality TV with ‘The 50’: I thrive in chaos
articles.summary: Sidharth Bhardwaj, known for his appearance on Bigg Boss 5, is making a return to reality television. He is set to feature in a new show titled 'The 50,' signaling his re-entry into the reality TV landscape. Bhardwaj expressed his characteristic enthusiasm for the format, stating, 'I thrive in chaos,' indicating his readiness for the challenges and dynamic nature of the competition.

articles.title: Derek Jeter defends Yankees owner Hal Steinbrenner amid growing fan criticism of team's title drought
articles.summary: The New York Yankees are largely retaining their 94-win roster for the upcoming season, a move that has drawn significant dissatisfaction from many fans. Despite the team's strong performance last year, narrowly missing the division title, supporters are unhappy with the decision to "run it back" without substantial changes. This strategy aims for continuity but faces fan backlash.

articles.title: Indonesia receives first Rafale advanced fighter jets from France, official says
articles.summary: Indonesia has received its first three Rafale fighter jets from France, marking the initial delivery from a multi-billion-dollar defence deal. This acquisition is crucial for bolstering Indonesia's air defence capabilities and signifies ongoing strategic cooperation between the two nations. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the importance of international defence partnerships and military modernization.

articles.title: UPSC Key: India-EU pact ready, Republic Day, and Padma awardees
articles.summary: This text outlines crucial exam topics for SSB aspirants. The Preliminary Examination covers current events of national and international significance. The Main Examination (General Studies-II, III) focuses on India's role in bilateral, regional, and global groupings and agreements, highlighting the importance of understanding international relations and geopolitics for effective preparation.
